reference_evidence_units.statement: A barrierless TICT channel in S1 quenches the enol emission.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the competitive interplay between excited-state intramolecular proton transfer (ESIPT) and twisted intramolecular charge transfer (TICT) processes was elucidated
reference_evidence_units.subject: HMP-pBr and HMP-pCH3
reference_evidence_units.statement: The photophysics is explained by competition between ESIPT and TICT.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT

reference_mechanisms.rationale: ESIPT (weak keto emission, assigned to S2) is half of the paper's central ESIPT/TICT competition; the authors themselves call the S2 assignment tentative.
